messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.metering.token_surge_unstable in us-west-2. Token_count +20% vs 1h baseline; several overage flags triggered. Severity: P2. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/8070012345
oncall-sre: ack. joining. Which tenants affected and are there customer notifications yet?
prod-alerts: automated overage warnings went to tenants: small-a, small-b at 02:14 UTC. Pausing further notifications on request.
billing-team: preliminary query shows a burst of duplicate message_ids from partition 7 between 02:10-02:18. Suspect consumer reprocessing due to preStop race during autoscaling event.
ingest-team: autoscaler restarted pods in us-west consumer group at ~02:11; preStop hook didn't wait for commits. pushing hotfix to ensure commit on termination.
oncall-sre: please mute alerts and prepare CS blurb.
cs: drafting note: "We observed transient incorrect usage indicators caused by internal processing duplicates. We are reconciling counts and will remove any erroneous overage markers promptly." Will finalize when we know scope.
ops: muting prod alerts now :white_check_mark:
billing-team: running dedupe window job for 02:08-02:20. Command: ./bin/dedupe --topic usage-usw --start 2026-03-21T02:08:00Z --end 2026-03-21T02:20:00Z --dry-run=false
billing-team: found ~2.1k duplicate msg_ids so far. Estimated net correction: -7,300 tokens.
ingest-team: hotfix deployed (canary). preventing new duplicates on canary node. planning rolling restart of remaining consumers with safe-drain.
incident-bot: metrics snapshot: token_rate +19.6% baseline; kafka.dup_rate 9.8%; consumer_lag us-west=87k
ops: performing rolling restart with safe-drain now (3/6 complete).
billing-team: dedupe job progress: 60% complete. expected finish ~6m.
prod-alerts: remains muted pending reconciliation.
billing-team: dedupe finished. total duplicates: 2,143; corrected tokens: -7,642. No invoices generated for the window.
cs: customer note ready. offering one-time courtesy credit if any customer shows a billing delta after reconciliation.
oncall-sre: recommend: 1) keep alerts muted until CS sends; 2) monitor counts for 30m; 3) postmortem to discuss preStop commit behavior.
ops: unmuting alerts after CS send.
prod-alerts: unmuted :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: final snapshot: token_rate +0.6% baseline; dup_rate ~0%; consumer_lag back to normal.
billing-team: will run overnight audit and follow up in postmortem.
cs: messages sent to affected tenants at 02:45 UTC. no escalations.
dev-ira: thanks team — noted for postmortem and follow-up with autoscaler config.
oncall-sre: incident moving to monitoring; will close in 1 hour if stable. Thanks everyone.
